theme_and_archetype.theme: Light Mode Primary (with Dark Mode support for Ops/Dashboards)
theme_and_archetype.vibe: Apple-level UI/UX, Liquid Glass, Enterprise-grade density, Indian Royal Velvet & Saffron Glow
theme_and_archetype.reasoning: Infused with ultra-premium warm accents (Coral Saffron/Teal Emerald) and Royal Velvet Indigo for an authoritative, stunning, and culturally resonant look.

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-semibold tracking-tight leading-none

marketing_page.style: Asymmetrical bento boxes, large typography, generous negative space.

dashboard.grid_mode: Mode B: The Control Room Grid
dashboard.style: Dense data widgets, full height usage, strict F-pattern alignment.

surface_styles.marketing_cards: bg-white border border-black/5 rounded-2xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 p-8
surface_styles.dashboard_widgets: bg-white border border-black/10 rounded-xl p-5 md:p-6 shadow-[0_2px_10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.02)]
surface_styles.glass_header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/75 border-b border-black/5 sticky top-0 z-50

animation_and_motion.rules: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. No aggressive bouncing. Smooth, Apple-like ease-out curves (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)).

component_rules.buttons: Rounded-full or rounded-xl (consistent), px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-all. Primary uses #E05236, secondary uses #F3F4F6 with dark text.
component_rules.tables: Shadcn UI table. Virtualized if huge. Sticky headers. text-sm for data density.
component_rules.inputs: Shadcn UI inputs. 1px border, subtle focus ring (ring-primary/20).
component_rules.charts: Recharts wrapped in Shadcn. Minimal grid lines, use primary/tertiary colors.
component_rules.forms: Use React Hook Form + Zod + Shadcn Form primitives.

marketing_hero.description: Modern architectural interior with a lone person

teacher_profile.placement: AI Teacher Assistant module visual or Teacher Dashboard Avatar

student_classroom.description: Two schoolboys in uniforms attentively listening
student_classroom.placement: Student Intelligence Platform / Academic Analytics section visual

abstract_glass.placement: Bento grid filler image or Parent App section background

accessibility_and_testing.testing_ids: CRITICAL: All buttons, links, form inputs, menus, and widgets MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit-button"`).
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure APCA/WCAG AA compliance. Text over images must use text-shadow or a gradient overlay.
accessibility_and_testing.aria: Use aria-labels for icon-only buttons (like sidebar toggles or action menus).

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a hybrid app: A Marketing Landing Page + A Dense Dashboard ERP.
Start by setting up the theme colors in tailwind.config.js using the hex codes provided in this JSON.
Install and configure 'Outfit' for headings and 'Manrope' for body text via Google Fonts.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for the Marketing Page to allow creative bento box layouts and asymmetrical spacing (p-12, gap-8).
Use Shadcn UI extensively for the Dashboard. Build a modular widget system using standard Tailwind grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with tight gaps (gap-6).
Implement an Apple-like 'Liquid Glass' sticky header for the marketing site using backdrop-blur-xl and bg-white/70.
Do NOT use pure #000000 or #808080. Follow the exact color palettes provided.
For all charts, use Recharts and map the colors to primary (#E05236) and tertiary (#4A7C59).
Include the provided image URLs exactly as they are. Do not use placeholders like via.placeholder.com.
Every interactive element must include a descriptive data-testid.
Ensure the dashboard handles multi-role logic seamlessly, updating the navigation and widget grid based on the role (Admin/Teacher/Parent/Student).
